complexity.tool: radon cc -s (grades); radon raw (module lloc); ast (function span + parameter count)
complexity.policy: Signals require review and a recorded disposition; they are not automatic violations.
complexity.regression_policy: Do not increase any baseline count or add a new Radon E/F symbol without a symbol-level rationale; refresh the snapshot only during a reviewed maintenance pass.

complexity.counting_convention: Authoritative rule is the one bootstrapper/tests/test_maintenance_baseline.py implements; match it exactly when refreshing. Scope: every non-hidden *.py under bootstrapper/ and services/backend/app/app/ (527 files at this refresh) — the leading-dot filter is what excludes bootstrapper/.venv, and an unfiltered glob inflates every count roughly 20x. radon_grade_c_or_worse counts blocks with complexity >= 11 EXCLUDING radon class blocks (block.letter != "C"), because a class block aggregates its own methods and would double-count the symbol-level baseline; counting class blocks too yields 359 rather than 358. Function span is physical lines (end_lineno - lineno + 1). Parameter count is posonly + args + kwonly + *args + **kwargs, counting self/cls. modules_over_600_logical_lines uses radon raw lloc, not a hand-rolled non-blank/non-comment count (36 under that rule, 14 under radon lloc).
